products.title: The Clock Hoodie
products.descriptionHtml:
A clock with its hands at 5:00. Quitting time.

It's the clock from the OFF SHFT logo, on its own. Shift's over. Hood up.

For the couch, the dock and the drive home.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: the clock, about 25 mm (1 in) tall, embroidered on all three styles
  • Styles: Oversized, Garment-Dyed or Lightweight
  • Oversized: relaxed fit, dropped shoulders. 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester fleece, 9.4 oz/yd² (319 g/m²). Lined hood with no drawcord, front kangaroo pocket
  • Garment-Dyed: relaxed fit. 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% polyester, 9.5 oz/yd² (322 g/m²), garment-dyed after sewing. Matching flat drawcords
  • Lightweight: relaxed fit. Lightweight fleece, 100% ring-spun cotton, 6.4 oz/yd² (217 g/m²), garment-dyed. Jersey-lined hood. Natural cream flat drawcords (White garments use white drawcords)

Which size? See Size & fit.
